text:
GENERATE BURST CS-dress-bridge — DRESS a crop of the painted cliffside level as a layered outdoor ARPG scene (Matt R-C3-68/73/79). task_id "CS-dress-bridge".

IMAGE 1 is a finished, BARE hand-painted 2D level crop (1536×1024) seen from a fixed high three-quarter ARPG camera (Diablo II / Last Epoch style): cliff-top grass and packed-dirt path at sunset, rocky rims, cliff faces and cloud banks; PURE GREEN #00ff00 = empty void. Sunset key light from the UPPER-LEFT; shadows fall to the LOWER-RIGHT.
IMAGE 2 is the SAME crop with SCALE FIGURES: the player character (1.75 m tall) pasted at her exact in-game size, with magenta ground and height ticks. IMAGE 3 is a SIZE CHART drawn in this exact camera projection: the character; a 0.7 m crate; a 0.9 m barrel; a 0.9 m rock; a 0.9 m shrub; the character; a 5 m dead snag; the character; a mature 8 m tree with a 5.5 m crown (the big circle); the character. IMAGE 4 is an APPROVED dressed crop of the same level — match its object style, detail and rendering exactly (not its layout). Paint every object at the size the figures and chart dictate. IMAGES 2–4 are references only — never paint figures, magenta lines, the grey chart, or copies of IMAGE 4's objects.
This crop is the BRIDGE APPROACH, where the forest fire reached the cliff edge. Add, in this priority: (1) two or three scorched dead snags (charred black trunks 3–5 m tall, a few broken branches, a faint ember glow in one crack) standing in the grass near the rims; (2) two blackened stumps, one still smouldering with a thin wisp of smoke; (3) a charred fallen log lying in the grass; (4) by the south end of the bridge, beside its posts but NOT on the deck or the path: a toppled wooden signpost and a coil of rope with one small crate; (5) a few blackened, leafless bushes.
Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 and deliver ONE 1536×1024 image: the SAME painting with those additions. Every tree and object stands ON the cliff-top grass (never on a cliff face, in a cloud, or on the green void) with a soft contact shadow in the same light; living trees cast dappled canopy shadows toward the lower-right. Same hand-painted register (tapered dark contours, painted planes, bold jewel tones), same camera angle and scale as the ground.
RULES: (a) everything that is not an added object or its shadow stays exactly as painted — no ground scorch marks, no repainting of grass, path, rims, faces, clouds or bridge; (b) the dirt path and the bridge deck stay open — trunks and props never stand on them (crowns may overhang); (c) every object, crown included, lies FULLY inside the image with at least 120 px margin from every border; (d) no trunk overlaps another trunk; objects do not overlap each other except a crown over something behind it; (e) no characters, creatures, text, UI, border or vignette; green stays flat pure #00ff00.

One image_gen call. ONE retry only if the ground outside the additions was visibly repainted, a rule (a)–(d) is broken, objects are clearly off-scale relative to the figures and chart, or a figure/magenta line was painted — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/dress_bridge.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-dress-bridge"; images = the file with prompt, references and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
